top_signals.title: Commission greenlights Poland's fifth payment request for €7.9 billion under NextGenerationEU
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 10 Aug 2026 Today, the European Commission positively assessed Poland's fifth payment request for €7.9 billion under the Recovery and Resilience Facility, the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU.
